facts.fact: Gates Foundation's 2023 grant record describes the national HMIS as the Ministry of Health's, which the grant is to help upgrade and maintain.
Gates Foundation committed USD 4,798,310 in 2023 (to 2027) to help Ethiopia's Ministry of Health upgrade and maintain the national HMIS.

note: The national HMIS is named only as a grant's object; no tiers, clinic share or governance is stated.

facts.fact: The DHIS2 country profile says Ethiopia's Ministry of Health began working toward full national implementation of DHIS2 as its HMIS in 2017, with HISP Ethiopia as technical partner.
The profile says that at many facilities and health posts data is collected on paper forms and then recorded in DHIS2 at the district level.
The Federal Ministry of Health transitioned its HMIS to a unified DHIS2 in 2017 across all regions and programs, per the Ethiopian Journal of Health Development case study.
